Shen Lab Custom ggplot2 Theme

Source: R/12_ggplot2_themes.R
theme_shenlab.Rd

A more polished ggplot2 theme built on theme_bw. It keeps the clean white background of theme_bw() while adding stronger hierarchy for titles, axes, legends, facet strips, and panel spacing.

Usage

theme_shenlab(base_size = 12, base_family = "", accent = "#1F4E79")

Arguments

base_size

Numeric. Base font size for text elements.

base_family

Character. Base font family passed to theme_bw().

accent

Character. Accent color used for titles and strip styling.

Value

A theme object that can be added to ggplot2 plots.

Details

This theme builds on theme_bw and customizes:

  • plot title, subtitle, caption, and tag styling;

  • axis text, axis ticks, and axis title emphasis;

  • major grid lines while removing minor grid lines;

  • legend placement and legend key cleanup;

  • facet strip backgrounds and text hierarchy;

  • panel borders, plot margins, and spacing.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Example scatter plot",
    subtitle = "theme_shenlab() on top of theme_bw()",
    x = "Miles per gallon",
    y = "Weight",
    color = "Cylinders"
  )
p + theme_shenlab()
